result:
I wrote the four answers to `answer.json`. The only thing I changed was creating that file; the repository is untouched.

| Question | Answer | How I found it |
|---|---|---|
| `parse_config_added_in` | `c78c29df311f0dc79aa3b0a49e3b1e2914160fb6` ("Read the config file") | This is the first commit that mentions `parseConfig`, and its diff adds `export function parseConfig(text) {`. |
| `legacy_deleted_in` | `4e1973b40d925918c479ef2731a8a65e8959d5db` ("Clean up old code") | This is the only commit that deletes `src/legacy.js`. |
| `most_changed_file` | `src/routes.js` | 20 commits changed it. The next most-changed file is `src/server.js`, with 9. |
| `lines_added_by_carol` | `73` | This is the sum of lines added across Carol Example's 19 commits. Changes to binary files are left out because they have no line counts. |

The history has no merge commits, so none of these counts include merges.
